reviews.text: Benqi is a lending protocol on Avalanche. Launched in 2021, it offers liquid staking. In 2025, it offers high yields with sAVAX. The team is audited. It’s an Avalanche DeFi staple.

Benqi is a decentralized lending protocol on Avalanche. Think of it as Aave/Compound for AVAX. Users can lend assets to earn interest and borrow against collateral. Launched in 2021, it reached around $344M TVL in mid-2025. Benqi is the Avalanche’s money market. It supports Avalanche’s liquid staked AVAX and other assets.

BENQI  is a decentralized finance protocol built on Avelanche which focuses on the liquidity market (Lending and borrowing)and  liquidity staking by leveraging Avelanche fast finality and cutting edge technology. The protocol was founded by an experienced  team from Rome Blockchain Labs Inc backed by VCs like Polychain Capital,  Dragonfly Capital and Mechanism Capital. BENQI has secured partnerships with multiple protocols like Avalanche Foundation, Chainlink, Trader Joe & Pangolin and Movement Labs. The protocol also  has robust security measures including multiple up to date audits and an active bug bounty program in addition to risk management and real time security solutions. QI token, the governance and utility token BENQI has nice and clear tokenomics and there is a gradual transition to community management  through DAO.
In my opinion, BENQI has good fundamentals but the major causes of concern about the project includes smart contract risks and intense competition from already established liquidity market protocols.

Benqi is basically the go to lending platform on Avalanche, and I think of it as the Aave equivalent in that ecosystem. It strikes me as solid it quickly built hundreds of millions in deposits on Avalanche. I appreciate that it taps Avalanche’s speed for fast loans and TVL. The caution I have is about Avalanche’s scale its DeFi market is still far smaller than Ethereum’s, so Benqi’s liquidity while big on Avalanche is limited by that. Plus, as always with lending, smart contract bugs or liquidation risk remain general concerns.

Benqi is a decentralized finance (DeFi) protocol built on the Avalanche blockchain, offering users lending and borrowing services with quick and low-cost transactions. With its focus on providing high-yield liquidity markets, Benqi aims to enhance DeFi access by leveraging the scalability and low transaction fees of Avalanche. Users can earn rewards through staking, liquidity provision, and interest-bearing assets, making Benqi a comprehensive DeFi solution for both casual and advanced crypto users. Despite being relatively new, Benqi’s integration with the Avalanche ecosystem has allowed it to grow rapidly and attract a strong community.
